name: greenfield
title: Greenfield: build the URL shortener from scratch

impl:T1.rationale: Package skeleton with typed, environment-driven settings so every later layer is configurable from day one.

impl:T2.rationale: CSPRNG-based base62 codes; validity check lets callers reject garbage without a database round trip.

impl:T3.rationale: All SQL isolated in the repository behind a small Database wrapper with explicit transactions and forward-only migrations.

impl:T4.rationale: Service layer with injected clock and code factory so collision handling and time-based statistics are deterministic under test.

impl:T5.rationale: Thin HTTP layer: routes delegate to the service, domain errors map to RFC 7807 problem responses, app built by a factory.

impl:T6.rationale: Unprivileged container with a data volume and a liveness-based health check.

documentation.rationale: README covering run, use, behaviour, configuration and layout; changelog entry for the initial release.

approvals.comment: Layering and migration approach are sound. Approved for implementation.
Checklist green, coverage above threshold. Promote.

faults.note: Simulated provider timeout to exercise bounded retry with backoff.
